verdict.rationale: Entra documents Lifecycle Workflows that run automatically against users across the three lifecycle phases (joiner/mover/leaver). It also documents automatic outbound SCIM provisioning of users and groups into SaaS and on-premises apps, which covers the downstream app-assignment half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows inbound HR-driven provisioning, i.e. an HRIS acting as the authoritative source that creates and updates directory users, so the core 'HR drives identity' element is only implied. Missing for 10: documented inbound HRIS-to-directory provisioning (e.g. HR connectors), evidence that HR attribute changes trigger mover and leaver updates to app assignments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
